summary: 2026 FIA WEC LMGT3: two silver/red Ferrari 296 LMGT3 Evos (#54, #21). Vista (Vista Global Holding Limited's brand) is the title brand on the doors/rear wing; Bombardier joined for 2026 on car #54 (plus Flohr's helmet, suit and trackwear), VistaJet on the bonnet/front, XO on wing endplate and sill, Richard Mille along the sidepod tops; Shell (pecten/V-Power), Pyypl (#21, render-based), Carlac Minerals (#21, render-based), Menoni, Sabelt, PILOTI and Delta Engineering complete the stickers. Not catalogued: the 'RNS' logo on the A-pillars and one unreadable white script logo on the side sill, and helmet/suit patches. Goodyear is WEC's exclusive LMGT3 tyre supplier and DHL appears in series-partner decal positions (both recorded as series deals); Ferrari badging is the manufacturer's, not sponsorship. sponsorsComplete false pending verification of these. Car placements recorded as 'partner' because the schema has no car-placement vocabulary.
